children.name: Proctoeces choerodoni Wee, Cribb, Bray & Cutmore, 2017
Proctoeces maculatus  Odhner, 1911
children.description: Body elongate. Oral sucker and pharynx well developed. There is a very short prepharynx. Esophagus short; ceca reaching is to posterior extremity. Acetabulum on short pedicle, in anterior third of body. Testes obliquely tandemly. Cirrus pouch reaching back of acetabulum, containing winding tubular seminal vesicle and long prostatic complex. Ovary pretesticular. No receptaculum seminis. Vitelline follicles in ovariotesticular zone. Uterus filling up all available space of hindbody. Excretory vesicle V-shaped.

Tergestia pauca Texeira de Freitas & Kohn, 1965
Symmetrovesicula gracilis Downie, Bray, Cribb & Jones, 2011
Steringovermes notacanthi Bray, 2004
children.description: Based on 13 wholemounted specimens, including 2 fully ovigerous and one set of serial sections. Body oval to fusiform 1,728 – 2,897 × 612 – 1,303 (2,211 × 871); width 28 – 48 (39) % of body­length. Tegument smooth. Oral sucker oval, subterminal, 256 – 445 × 247 – 460 (342 × 342). Ventral sucker in mid­body, oval, 373 – 708 × 335 – 779 (549 × 516). Sucker­width ratio 1: 1.4 – 1.8 (1.6); sucker­length ratio 1: 1.4 – 1.7 (1.5). Forebody 735 – 1,126 (912), 38 – 46 (41) % of body­length. Prepharynx absent. Pharynx large, elongate oval, 218 – 350 × 140 – 277 (281 × 213). Oral sucker to pharynx width ratio 1: 0.6 – 0.7 (0.6). Oesophagus short, 35 – 91 (54) long. Intestinal bifurcation in mid­forebody, 168 – 359 (286) from ventral sucker. Caeca reach mid­post­testicular region, terminate blindly 193 – 504 (339) from posterior extremity. Testes 2, oval, entire or irregular, symmetrical, overlap posterior margin of ventral sucker, 182 – 441 × 170 – 310 (285 × 217), contiguous to 350 (51) apart, pre­ovarian. Posttesticular region 387 – 860 (629) long, 22 – 34 (28) % of body­length. Cirrus­sac large, oval, 317 – 618 × 151 – 348 (427 × 234). Seminal vesicle internal, bipartite, small; proximal part short, coiled tubular, wall thin, membranous; distal part oval, with wall 3.5 – 4 µm thick. Pars prostatica wide. Ejaculatory duct large, wide, pocketed.

children.name: Oceroma praecox  Cribb, Miller, Bray & Cutmore, 2014
Thryssatrema hanumantharaoi Sailaja & Madhavi, 2012
children.description: (Based on 6 whole mounts) Body elongate, broad posteriorly, tapering anteriorly, 2,400 – 3,312 (2,878) long, 330 – 624 (506) wide, maximum width at between vitellaria and ventral sucker. Tegument aspinose, thin, transparent. Suckers poorly developed, subterminal oral sucker somewhat funnel-shaped, almost square, 88 – 172 (126) long, 98 – 156 (130) wide; ventral sucker small, circular, rudimentary, 48 – 80 (60) in diameter. Sucker ratio 1: 0.34 – 1: 0.57 (1: 0.48). Forebody highly extensile, length variable depending on degree of contraction during fixation, 234 - 650 (450) long. Prepharynx absent. Pharynx oval, 60 – 88 (72) in diameter, major part of it lies dorsal to oral sucker. Esophagus narrow, 80 – 200 (136) long, bifurcation immediately anterior to ventral sucker. Ceca slender, reach to posterior extremity and end blindly. Testes two, oval, fairly large, subequal in size, right testis 216 – 408 (304) long, 120 – 240 (152) wide; left testis 216 – 408 (296) long, 112 – 240 (168) wide, symmetrically arranged in posterior half of hindbody, separated by uterine coils; posttesticular space 560 – 860 (624) long. Distance between ventral sucker and anterior margin of testes 800 – 1,680 (1,058 )). Cirrus sac small, claviform, extends posterior to ventral sucker, 140 – 310 (212) long, 68 – 100 (90) wide. Seminal vesicle bipartite, both chambers of same size, in posterior half of cirrus sac. Pars prostatica vesicular; prostatic cells small, numerous.
